description: This file defines functions and types for auditing and summarizing task-related data, including finding inconsistencies, stale tasks, and errors in task processing.

methods.name: createFinding
methods.description: Creates a task audit finding object with specified parameters.

methods.name: taskReferenceAt
methods.description: Returns the most relevant timestamp for a task (lastEventAt, startedAt, or createdAt).

methods.name: findTimestampInconsistency
methods.description: Checks for timestamp inconsistencies in a task and returns a warning finding if any are found.

methods.name: compareFindings
methods.description: Comparator function for sorting findings based on severity, age, and creation time.

methods.name: listTaskAuditFindings
methods.description: Generates a list of audit findings for tasks based on their current state and configured thresholds.

methods.name: summarizeTaskAuditFindings
methods.description: Summarizes a collection of findings into an audit summary with counts of total, errors, and warnings.
